caption_segments: A static top-down shot captures a blue pool table where a hand wearing a black glove aims a wooden cue stick at the white cue ball near the bottom left, surrounded by scattered colored balls.
The overhead artificial lights suddenly begin to flicker and dim, causing the shadows on the blue felt to deepen and the colors of the pool balls to desaturate as the cue stick strikes forward.
The scene is plunged into heavy darkness as the lights fail completely, hiding the pool table and the moving balls in deep shadow with only the faint outline of the table frame visible.
The lighting system sputters back to life, slowly washing over the table and revealing the blue felt once more as the dimness recedes and details of the scattered balls reappear.
With the lights fully restored, the black eight-ball is visible inside the top-left corner pocket, the white cue ball rests against the bottom-left rail, and the red ball lies near the right cushion.
